source_caption:
🎬 In Time (2011)

In Time takes place in a futuristic world where people stop aging at 25, but time has become the world’s most valuable currency. Everyone must earn, spend, or steal time to stay alive, while the wealthy can live for centuries and the poor struggle to survive each day. Will Salas, a young factory worker living in poverty, unexpectedly receives a fortune in time from a mysterious stranger, making him a target of the authorities. Determined to challenge the unfair system, Will crosses paths with Sylvia Weis, the daughter of a powerful billionaire, and together they embark on a dangerous mission to expose the truth behind society’s inequality. As they race against the clock, they face relentless pursuit, dangerous criminals, and impossible decisions. Starring Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried, In Time combines thrilling action, romance, and science fiction while exploring wealth, survival, freedom, and the true value of time.

🎭 Genre: Action • Sci-Fi • Thriller • Romance

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 49m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Andrew Niccol

✍️ Writer: Andrew Niccol

source_details.synopsis: In Time is a 2011 American science fiction action film written, co-produced, and directed by Andrew Niccol. Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried star as inhabitants of a dystopian future where time is its primary currency; each individual possesses a subdermal tattoo-like countdown digital clock on their left forearm that kills them when they 'time out'. Cillian Murphy, Vincent Kartheiser, Olivia Wilde, Matt Bomer, Johnny Galecki, and Alex Pettyfer costar. The film was released on October 28, 2011, and grossed $174 million against a $40 million budget. It received mixed reviews from critics, who praised the premise while criticizing its execution.
